affiliations.occupation: Semiskilled occupation in the fabrication of metal products, not elsewhere classified
affiliations.date_precision: Civilian-occupation code 693 was recorded at Army entry on 12 January 1942. The broad code names no employer, workplace, specific trade, start date or Army-to-OSS transfer date.
affiliations.research_notes: The exact private identifier confirms the punctuation-normalized Army-entry row. The category does not establish a company, metalworking trade, plant or the later Army-to-OSS sequence.

affiliations.date_precision: Civilian-occupation code 137 was recorded at Army entry on 13 March 1943. The code groups stenographers and typists and supplies no employer, workplace, exact title, start date or Army-to-OSS transfer date.
affiliations.research_notes: The exact private identifier and exact full name confirm the row. The historical category is not converted into a named employer or a choice between its two occupations.
